title: NYDFS announces $6.75 million cybersecurity penalties for Rocket Mortgage and Mr. Cooper
date_note: The day of the DFS press release; the page gives no consent order dates.
place: New York State Department of Financial Services, New York
geo_basis: the regulator, New York State Department of Financial Services
summary: The New York State Department of Financial Services says Rocket Mortgage will pay a total of $6.75 million in penalties under consent orders: $2 million for Rocket Mortgage and $4.75 million for Nationstar Mortgage (Mr. Cooper). DFS says Rocket Mortgage reported cybersecurity incidents late on seven occasions and did not implement multi-factor authentication. DFS says Mr. Cooper failed to complete a comprehensive risk assessment for almost four years.
plain: New York's financial regulator says Rocket Mortgage will pay a total of $6.75 million over cybersecurity failures at itself and at Mr. Cooper, including late incident reports and missing multi-factor authentication.
exec: DFS says Rocket Mortgage will pay a total of $6.75 million in penalties for breaches of New York's cybersecurity regulation by itself and Mr. Cooper.
